name: Linked trace projection
purpose: A point turning round a circle carries its height across to a graph that draws itself; both views come from one angle so they never drift apart.

implementation.api: Studio.comp.tracePair(parent, {cycles, period, label}, {width, height}) -> {enter, run(tl, at, {cycles, period}), exit, geometry}

layout_notes: SVG sized to its parent; circle at the left, graph to the right at the same centre line.

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/explain-devices.html (63 checks incl. seek-order independence) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; golden scene tests/reference-derived/explain-equation-trace/index.html frame review 0 errors 0 warnings and contact sheet inspected. Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
